summary.name: Easy-Peasy.ai
summary.one_liner: Easy-Peasy.ai is an all-in-one AI platform for generating images, videos, voices, text, transcriptions and other content, plus an agent called Marky, under a subscription.
use_cases: create short cinematic videos from text
make a talking presenter video from a photo
write blog posts and marketing copy
get AI professional headshots from selfies
summary.what_it_does: The page lists image generation with 40+ models up to 4K, video generation using Seedance 2.0 and Veo, and talking avatars that add lip-sync to a photo. It offers text to speech in 30+ languages, AI headshots, and audio transcription. Marky is an agent that chats with top models and can build websites, research the web, analyze files and create slides. Paid plans give word allowances for models such as GPT-5, Claude Sonnet and Gemini Pro, plus image/video credits, transcription minutes, bots, brand voices and API access on the top tier.
notable: Marky agent that can build websites, research, analyze files and create slides
Access to 40+ image models and video models such as Seedance 2.0 and Veo
Free tier with no credit card required; paid tiers with a 30-day money-back guarantee
Generated assets belong to the user and the company says it does not train on user data
caveats: Free plan limits usage (1,000 words, 1 image credit) and makes generated images public
Higher tiers are paid subscriptions; annual billing offers a 40% discount
Some features such as API access and unlimited transcription are only on the top tier
